visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a black leather jacket over a blue top, stands outdoors. She faces the camera while holding a device, possibly a phone, in a selfie perspective. Behind her is a massive, ornate stone building with intricate baroque-style carvings and several statues set in niches. The lighting is natural daylight with a clear sky visible. (2) The camera cuts to a wide, low-angle shot of two large stone bell towers of the same building, reaching towards a bright blue sky with wispy white clouds. Small figures of people walk on the plaza at the base. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the dome of the cathedral, which is constructed from weathered stone and topped with an intricate iron cross and a globe-like structure. (4) The scene shifts indoors to a high-angle shot looking up at a vaulted cathedral ceiling. The architecture is grand, featuring elaborate golden carvings, statues of angels with outstretched wings, and a circular skylight at the very top. (5) The woman reappears in an eye-level medium close-up shot, standing inside the cathedral. She gestures with her hands as she looks around the dimly lit interior, which features rows of wooden pews and massive stone columns. (6) A close-up shot displays a framed classical painting. The artwork depicts a woman in a red and gold gown holding up a white cloth that bears the face of a bearded man, resembling Jesus. (7) The woman is shown again in the cathedral's interior, looking towards the camera and then glancing to her left. She holds a green brochure or map in her hand. (8) A close-up shot shows a stained-glass window panel depicting a religious figure holding a similar cloth with a face on it, set against a blue, starry background. (9) The woman continues her walk through the cathedral, passing by pews and large ornamental railings. The background shows blurred figures of other visitors and the vast, echoing space of the church with its checkered floor.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator introduces the Jaén Cathedral in Spain and recounts the religious legend of Saint Veronica and her veil. She explains that the sacred relic is kept at this cathedral but only shown on Fridays. Since she visited on a Saturday, she expresses regret at missing the display.
